repositoryImplementationHead.evidenceMeaning: Exact-head repository implementation and hardened Azure verification harness passed Fast, including managed-Istio rollout convergence, managed external ingress readiness, temporary AKS verification RBAC cleanup, configuration/identity and traffic/adverse evidence contracts, conservation gates, Python syntax, Go suite and PostgreSQL tagged compile. This remains repository evidence and does not verify live AKS service trust.

realAzureAttemptEvidence.meaning: Real Azure evidence exposed managed-Istio rollout CPU pressure and absent managed external ingress realization on the two-node system pool. Failure evidence was retained and temporary verification RBAC cleanup succeeded.

Terraform correctly planned only the AKS system-pool scale from two to three Standard_DC2s_v3 nodes (0 add, 1 change, 0 destroy), but Azure rejected apply with ErrCode_InsufficientVCPUQuota: Canada Central regional vCPU quota had 0 remaining and the additional node required 2 vCPUs. The subscription is an Azure Free Trial and the portal reports it is ineligible for quota adjustment unless upgraded to a paid subscription.

externalBlockerDisposition.revisitTrigger: A no-cost eligible subscription/quota or later authorized paid environment becomes available for the exact live AKS verification drill.
externalBlockerDisposition.rationale: Development should not require the owner to purchase Azure quota solely to produce external managed-infrastructure evidence. Repository implementation remains fail-closed and the real failures are retained. The missing live proof stays explicit instead of weakening Istio, TLS, network, identity, cleanup or drift requirements to fit the free tier.

closureBoundary: HOST-013..014 remains IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED until the existing manual CI Qualified Azure operator passes on a sufficiently resourced isolated non-production AKS environment and proves the full configuration/identity/traffic/cleanup/zero-drift chain. The named Azure Free Trial vCPU quota constraint is accepted as a Development-tier external blocker for dependency-band advancement and may be carried explicitly into HOST-023 under the existing named-external-blocker rule.
